note: Prosthodontic QA 1405/08/06 (2026-10-28), orchestrator follow-up to agents A and B (A107/A108). Agent A found that «لق شدن روکش» — the phrase a dentist types for a loose crown on a natural tooth — was an alias of #شل_شدن_پیچ (implant screw loosening), so the lexical path sent a tooth-crown question to four implant pages. #افتادن_روکش (12 pages; definition: loss of retention and dislodgement of a crown from its abutment) is the concept that resolves it. The phrase moves there; #شل_شدن_پیچ keeps its screw spellings and gains the explicit «لق شدن روکش ایمپلنت» so a loose implant crown still reaches it (longest alias wins). Both lists are complete replacements of the current aliases; no other field changes.
